source_text: A review of 360 fistula patients in Niger found 10 cases (2.8%) directly resulting from analogous gurya cuttings performed for similar indications, all requiring reconstructive surgery for continence restoration, highlighting the procedure's net morbidity without biomedical validation. [8]
